Chapter 692 - 692 The Five Masters Of Gray Planet; A Threat

Chapter 692 - 692 The Five Masters of Gray Planet; A Threat

692 The Five Masters of Gray Planet; A Threat

The Heavenly Wind World also had day and night.

In the blink of an eye, two months had passed.

In the past two months, Lin Fan had brought Ma Zheng through the forest, killing beasts one after another.

At this moment, Lin Fan had already obtained 35 Spiritual Pearls!

He directly gave Ma Zheng ten Spiritual Pearls.

After all, from a certain perspective, Ma Zheng had given Lin Fan some help.

Furthermore, it was useless for Lin Fan to ask for too many Spiritual Pearls.

But for Ma Zheng, it was completely different.

He had entered the Heavenly Wind World only to look for opportunities in the outer regions. He had never dreamed of entering the core region.

In the end, in just half a month, he had the qualifications to enter the core area!

To Ma Zheng, this was simply like a dream.

At the same time, he had a deeper understanding of Lin Fan’s strength.

No matter if it was a low-level, mid-level, or even high-level Star Traveller beast, Lin Fan killed them all with a single slash. There were no exceptions.

Gradually, Ma Zheng had a guess in his heart…

Perhaps, Lin Fan’s cultivation state had already reached the Planet level!

A Planet level genius below 10,000 years old!

Unimaginable!

….

Lin Fan did not care about what Ma Zheng was thinking.

He focused his attention on the system.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Star Traveller Level 7 (900,000/2,000,000)]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Mortal), Curse (Emperor), Sword Nurturing Technique (Emperor), Cosmos Sword Technique (Emperor)]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Ordinary Rank), Flame Armor (Emperor Rank), Heavenly Soul Pearl (Emperor Rank), True Dragon Sword (Emperor Rank)]

[Laws: Time (elementary), Space (intermediate), Metal (elementary), Wood (elementary), Water (elementary), Fire (intermediate), Earth (elementary)]

[Character Relationship:]

[Lin Tao: Daddy; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom; Favorability:Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing, Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Qin Dachuan: Enemy; Hatred Points: 3 stars.]

Lin Fan felt the energy surging in his body and was extremely happy.

At this moment, a loud noise came from afar.

Tens of kilometers away, Qin Dachuan, the black-robed man, and several men in armor were being chased by dozens of powerful exotic beasts.

They were in a sorry state, and their faces were filled with panic and fatigue.

“Damn it! Why did another mutated beast appear?”

“Why is the Heavenly Wind World so dangerous?”

Dangerous?

That was right!

It was dangerous!

Ever since they entered the Heavenly Wind World, they had encountered an endless stream of strange beasts.

At first, they did not think much of it.

They were even a little happy.

That was because after killing a mutated beast, they actually found a Spiritual Pearl inside.

If they could obtain a Spiritual Pearl for every exotic beast killed, would they not be able to enter the core area very quickly.

But gradually, they did not think so.

That was because the number of exotic beasts attacking them was increasing, making it impossible for them to resist at all. They could only run.

In fact, as time passed, it became very difficult to escape.

As early as ten days ago, there were already casualties.

However, the number of mutated beasts was still increasing.

It was as if they would not stop until they devoured them completely.

“The previous Heavenly Wind World definitely wasn’t this dangerous!”

“Why does it feel like a curse?”

“Damn it!”

They did not take it to heart, though.

They did not know that this was the truth.

A man in armor was accidentally torn into pieces by a giant mantis, and blood splattered everywhere.

“This is bad, they’re surrounding us!”

“No!”

Soon, Qin Dachuan and his group were completely engulfed by the monsters. They screamed incessantly.

“I’ll fight it out with you!”

The black-robed man took out an energy crystal the size of a basketball.

In an instant, a terrifying energy suddenly erupted. The surrounding trees and stones instantly turned into nothingness.

Peace returned.

It was also at this moment…

A crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Your enemy, Qin Dachuan, died due to the explosion of the energy crystal.]

A moment later, Lin Fan and Ma Zheng arrived at the scene of the explosion.

A huge pit appeared on the ground.

Some exotic beasts with broken limbs were still struggling to crawl in the holes.

Lin Fan picked up the True Dragon Sword and waved it around.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-three Planet level exotic beast. You’ve obtained 30,000 experience points.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-five Planet level exotic beast. You’ve obtained 50,000 experience points.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-four Planet level exotic beast. You’ve obtained 40,000 experience points.]

…

Lin Fan had killed 15 beasts easily, earning a total of 600,000 experience points.

The surging energy kept rippling in his body.

Then, with a casual wave of his hand, the 11 Spiritual Pearls hidden in the bodies of the mutated beasts appeared in his hand.

Lin Fan could feel the increase in energy within his body. He then looked at the Spiritual Pearls in his hand and had a strange look on his face.

His enemy helped him earn 600,000 experience points and 11 Spiritual Pearls?

That was actually reasonable.

After all, if Lin Fan were to find and kill these beasts by himself, he would definitely have to spend a certain amount of time.

“Tsk tsk, kid, hand over all the Spiritual Pearls! I can spare your life!”

Not far away, an ear-piercing sound came.

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng looked over.

Five white-robed men emerged from the darkness.

They were staring at Lin Fan and Ma Zheng with their cold eyes.

They looked like hungry wolves staring at two fat sheep. They were extremely unscrupulous.

When Ma Zheng saw the clothes of the five people, especially the moon symbol on their arms, his pupils constricted slightly. He said in shock, “The Five Masters of Gray Planet!”

“You know them?” Lin Fan asked.

“The Five Masters of Gray Planet are all disciples of Star Lord Cang,” Ma Zheng said in a low voice. “They’re all mid-level Planet geniuses younger than 10,000 years old! Their strength is extremely terrifying, and their attacks are also extremely decisive!”

The man standing in the middle grinned and said, “So, you know us. That’s good! I hope we don’t waste our time, because time… is life!”

When he said the word ‘life’, his body emitted a killing intent that was almost tangible.

The threat was obvious.

Ma Zheng was only an initial-stage Planet cultivator, so how could he withstand such an aura? He could not help but shiver.

A threat?

Regardless of whether it was when Lin Fan was a Chaos Dragon God or when he was living on Earth, the thing he hated the most was threats.

Lin Fan looked at the five of them coldly as if he was looking at five cold corpses.

“Is that so? I don’t like wasting time either, so you can all go to hell.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan pulled out the True Dragon Sword.

A deafening dragon roar resounded in all directions.

A sharp sword light turned into a galloping dragon and passed through the white-robed man standing in the middle.
